text:
You need a clean list of female podcasters in the USA with email, mobile number, and Instagram handle, filtered to 2K–50K followers, and you want to know how many contacts I can deliver in 3 business days and at what cost.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in data analysis, data cleaning, and contact research using SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. I built a Dental clinic expansion model for Sunrise Dental Partners in Excel, comparing 3 sites with best/base/worst cases and helping identify a site projected to pay back in 14 months.

For your project, I can compile and organize verified contact lists efficiently, with careful attention to follower range and data quality. If you’d like, I can outline a realistic delivery estimate and pricing based on the volume you want.
